sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Identify the correct intensifier for each register, then compare neutral vs. intensified versions
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите подходящий усилитель для каждого регистра и сравните нейтральные и усиленные версии

items.promptEnglish: This is an extremely important question. (formal register)
items.hint: A formal intensifier stronger than очень, appropriate for official speech.
items.explanation: Крайне (extremely) is a formal intensifier. Очень is neutral, while ужасно and жутко are colloquial.

items.prompt: Academic writing: Результаты эксперимента оказались _____ значимыми.
items.promptEnglish: The experiment results turned out to be extraordinarily significant.
items.hint: The most formal intensifier, suitable for academic and official texts.
items.explanation: Чрезвычайно (extraordinarily) is the highest-register intensifier. Страшно, ужасно, and жутко are colloquial and inappropriate for academic writing.

items.promptEnglish: What a darling/sweet little kitten! (intensified with пре-)
items.hint: The prefix пре- intensifies the adjective, meaning 'very sweet/darling.'
items.explanation: Премилый = пре- + милый, meaning 'very sweet/darling.' The prefix пре- adds an intensifying, often slightly old-fashioned or affectionate overtone.

items.promptEnglish: He is quite an educated person. (formal, slightly bookish)
items.hint: A formal, slightly bookish intensifier meaning 'quite/rather.'
items.explanation: Весьма (quite, rather) is formal and slightly bookish. It conveys measured emphasis without the extremity of крайне or чрезвычайно.

items.promptEnglish: That happened a very long time ago.
items.hint: The first part of this reduplication pair is a modified form of the root.
items.explanation: Давным-давно (long, long ago) is a fixed reduplication pattern where the first element takes the instrumental-like suffix -ым.

minimalPairs.context: A narrator in a fairy tale describes a house:
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Choose the version with expressive reduplication.
minimalPairs.explanation: Большой-большой (very very big) uses reduplication, a pattern common in fairy tales and spoken narratives for vivid, emotional emphasis.

translation.english: This problem is extremely serious. (formal, for a report)
translation.hint: Use крайне for formal 'extremely' before the adjective.

translation.english: She is terribly tired after work. (casual speech)
translation.hint: Use ужасно or страшно for colloquial 'terribly.'

translation.english: The road was very very long. (expressive, storytelling style)
translation.hint: Use reduplication of the adjective for expressive storytelling.

translation.english: He is quite a talented musician. (formal, bookish)
translation.hint: Use весьма for formal, slightly bookish 'quite.'
